authors: I. Jack, D.R.T. Jones, C.G. North
title: N=1 supersymmetry and the three loop anomalous dimension for the chiral superfield
claim: The three-loop anomalous dimension of the chiral superfield in a general N=1 supersymmetric gauge theory is computed and used to probe renormalization-invariant relations between Yukawa and gauge couplings (v2 adds the Wess-Zumino special case).
theory: general N=1 supersymmetric gauge theory with chiral matter
scheme: Not stated in the abstract; in this programme (cf. S1e.03_JJN1996c) calculations use superspace DRED with minimal subtraction (DRED-bar).
symmetry_argument: Manifest N=1 superspace (supergraphs) with DRED: SUSY assumed preserved by the superspace D-algebra performed in 4d followed by d-dimensional momentum integrals.

proved: Three-loop gamma for general N=1 theories (abstract).
assumed: SUSY of the superspace DRED computation (not discussed in the abstract).

red_flags: Scheme not stated on the abstract page; DRED usage inferred from companion papers.
notes: Brief lead hep-ph/9603386 was labelled as a gauge-beta paper in passing; it is actually the chiral-superfield anomalous-dimension paper.
